scenarios.scenario: Insight — Inspect Distrib property across projects in signing build
scenarios.reasoning: The agent was efficient and got the DataSources Distrib value right, but reached the wrong conclusion on the core question — asserting no shared output directories despite an explicit tool hint that unset properties may still be inherited/shared. It substituted a different root cause and stated it confidently, missing the intended diagnosis. Final turn also wasted on restating findings after a stale shell read.

rubricScores.criterion: Found the Distrib property value for the DataSources project
Checked whether other projects (Common, StorageLibrary) use the same Distrib path
Identified that multiple projects point to the same shared output folder
Explained how this shared folder causes the signing conflict
